key_insight: Adaptive discretization and iterative local spin-glass mappings enable continuous-variable optimization on qubit-based architectures without a fixed search grid.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a flexible way to translate continuous engineering objectives into solver-compatible problems for quantum and quantum-inspired pipelines.
method: Adapt the finite encoding of continuous variables during optimization.
Iteratively map the objective locally onto an effective spin-glass Hamiltonian.
Solve the mapped problems within a qubit-compatible optimization pipeline.
evidence_signal: Tests on unconstrained and constrained n-dimensional Gramacy-Lee benchmarks and a proof-of-concept radiotherapy inverse-planning problem yielded competitive solutions, according to the abstract.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify scaling, mapping overhead, or advantage over classical solvers, leaving practical performance uncertain.
paper_title: Adaptive Qubit Encoding for Continuous-Variable Quantum Optimization
